title: Vintage Rhode Island Lobster Shot Glass Souvenir Barware
descriptionText:
Souvenir style Rhode Island lobster shot glass with bold red and black lobster graphic. Clear glass, heavy base, sturdy construction. Great for collectors, souvenir displays, coastal bar setups, or giftable VTG barware additions. No chips or cracks. Light surface wear consistent with age and use. Graphic and lettering remain vibrant.
Approximate size:
Height: 2.4 in
Diameter (rim): 1.9 in
Base: 1.4 in
Weight: 4.2 oz
